cards.name: optimism under uncertainty
cards.upper_planning_use: Generate candidate routes for index-based stochastic bandit and finite-horizon RL regret proofs.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Do not cite optimism as a theorem; instantiate local index definitions, confidence events, and compiled pull-count/regret leaves.
blocked_leaves: positive pull count before index use

cards.name: sub-Gaussian, Hoeffding, Chernoff, and variance tails
cards.upper_planning_use: Select the weakest tail route matching reward assumptions: bounded, sub-Gaussian, conditional sub-Gaussian, or finite-variance.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Use Mathlib/LML declarations or task-local cited results; do not reprove a tail inequality inside an algorithm file.

cards.name: Tsallis entropy FTRL and best-of-both-worlds bandits
cards.upper_planning_use: Propose routes for stochastic/adversarial interpolation, self-bounding regret, and adaptive learning-rate FTRL tasks.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Do not treat the weapon as a reusable theorem; first formalize Tsallis regularizer, simplex constraints, FTRL optimality, and stability/penalty leaves.

cards.name: exponential weights potential
cards.upper_planning_use: Plan adversarial finite-arm regret proofs using importance-weighted losses and potential telescoping.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Use exact exponential/log inequalities from Mathlib and expose estimator unbiasedness as separate leaves.

cards.name: self-normalized concentration for OFUL/LinUCB
cards.upper_planning_use: Route linear/GLM bandit proofs through Gram matrix monotonicity, confidence ellipsoids, and elliptical potential.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Separate linear algebra leaves from stochastic-process leaves; do not hide determinant or norm side conditions.

cards.name: posterior sampling and probability matching
cards.upper_planning_use: Plan Thompson-sampling and Bayesian regret proofs around posterior action identities and Bayes-risk decompositions.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Use LML posterior theorem cards when available; otherwise formalize kernels and conditional distributions before regret algebra.

cards.name: KL change-of-measure and information lower bounds
cards.upper_planning_use: Generate lower-bound and KL-UCB confidence-inversion routes for Bernoulli or bounded reward models.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Record KL definitions, convexity, and absolute-continuity assumptions explicitly before any theorem reuse.

cards.name: primal-dual resource accounting for bandits with knapsacks
cards.upper_planning_use: Plan resource-constrained bandit proofs through budget traces, stopping times, and Lagrangian comparisons.
cards.lower_agent_rule: Expose budget feasibility and stopping-time assumptions as reusable contracts before final regret proof work.
